quizName:
Hardest Questions in Ohio
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on the interstate, what should you do?

options.text: Quickly cut across traffic to make your turn.
Make a U-turn to go back to the exit.
Continue driving and use the next exit.
Put your vehicle in reverse to go back to the exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving and use the next exit.
questions.explanation: Do not make a sudden turn to catch your exit. Continue to the next exit instead.

questions.question: When you see a railroad crossing warning sign, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up to cross before a train arrives.
Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Look for a way around any lowered gates.
Assume no trains are near and drive normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing warning signs alert you to a possible train. Always obey these signs and never go around barriers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready to stop for a red light or watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns you of an upcoming railroad crossing. Watch for signs of a train and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means that action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot continue in your current direction.

questions.question: If you are in an accident, what should you do?
questions.explanation: In an accident, stop immediately and move your vehicle out of traffic if possible. Call the police and ask for an ambulance if needed. Try to stop serious bleeding with direct pressure. Wait for emergency services to arrive.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on a green light must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on a green light must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic signal. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and cars with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Ignore how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be prepared to stop for trains or other vehicles on the tracks.

questions.question: You hear a siren behind your car. What should you do?

options.text: Move to the right side of the road and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an emergency vehicle behind you, move to the right side of the road and stop safely. Slow down if needed. If you are in heavy traffic, move slowly until you can get out of the way.

questions.question: Where is parking not allowed?
questions.explanation: Do not park on a crosswalk, on a highway bridge, or in a tunnel. Only park where it is legal and where other drivers can see your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop and yield the right-of-way. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross here.

questions.question: You must stop your vehicle:

options.text: At an intersection with a stop sign.
When a traffic officer tells you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop at stop signs, red lights, and whenever a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.question: This sign shows a type of:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted. Drivers must follow all regulation signs.

questions.question: What is the best way to avoid hydroplaning?

options.text: Slow down when roads are wet or slushy.
Watch out for standing water or puddles.

questions.explanation: When roads are wet, your car needs more distance to stop and may skid during quick turns. Reduce your speed and do not use cruise control in wet or icy conditions. Keep your tires in good condition and avoid standing water.

questions.question: What is the most effective way to reduce your risk of injury or death in a traffic crash?

options.text: Stay in the right lane on multilane highways.
Limit your driving to hours between 3:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m.

questions.explanation: Wearing your seat belt is the single most effective thing you can do to reduce your risk of death or injury while driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means parking is not allowed where this sign is posted. Drivers must follow all regulation signs.

questions.question: When is street racing acceptable?
questions.explanation: Street racing is illegal and can cause serious injury or death. Illegal street races are held on public roads and put other drivers at risk. High speeds make it impossible for drivers to react to hazards or other traffic, which often causes crashes.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove of their behavior.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If another driver is driving dangerously, stay calm and create distance between your vehicles. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make gestures at them.

questions.question: Why shouldn't you follow other cars too closely?

options.text: You may not see the road between the cars.
You may not have time to stop if the vehicle in front of you slows or stops suddenly.
You may not see the vehicle's turn signals.
You may not see the other vehicle's brake lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may not have time to stop if the vehicle in front of you slows or stops suddenly.
questions.explanation: If you follow too closely, you may not have enough time to stop if the car in front of you suddenly slows or stops. This can cause a collision.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What is the only way to reduce your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: Allow your body time to get rid of the alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allow your body time to get rid of the alcohol.
questions.explanation: Only time can lower your BAC. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers cannot lower your BAC or make you sober. They may help you stay awake, but they cannot change your BAC.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot turn left. It is a regulation sign that drivers must obey.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts to cross in front of your vehicle. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian cross.
questions.explanation: You must always give pedestrians the right of way. Stop and let them cross safely. Be extra careful near children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: Which of these commonly causes traffic accidents?

options.text: Driving too fast for the conditions

questions.explanation: Speeding, not paying attention, and tailgating all cause accidents. Most rear-end collisions happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: Before you start the engine, you should:

options.text: Make sure only back seat passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Make sure only adult passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Make sure only child passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Make sure everyone in the vehicle has buckled their seat belt.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure everyone in the vehicle has buckled their seat belt.
questions.explanation: Before starting the car, buckle your own seat belt and make sure all passengers buckle theirs too.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: If you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When leaving your vehicle, turn off the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in school zones?
questions.explanation: The speed limit in school zones is 20 mph unless a different sign is posted. Always drive carefully in school zones.

questions.question: Which of these substances can impair your driving and result in a DUI arrest?

options.text: Inhalants, such as glue or paint

questions.explanation: Alcohol, illegal drugs, inhalants, and some legal medicines can all impair your driving. Any of these can result in a DUI arrest.
